artifact.name: GLM-5.2 Neimeng PP4 controlled 100K exact-90%-cache kernel MFU
artifact.run_shape: standalone SGLang TP=1 DP=1 PP=4; 600 simultaneous 100K prompts; exact 90% aggregate in-GPU radix hit; one output token; full drain

guardian.lifecycle_gate: start -> pre-idle -> multiple gpu_pids=4 -> post-idle -> stop

run_provenance.import_note: The in-container finalizer selected the incompatible Nsight Compute importer. The complete QDSTRM was retained and recovered with the node-host Nsight Systems 2025.3.2 importer, then exported to SQLite with exit code 0.
run_provenance.model_content_digest: model.safetensors.index.json sha256:2aa8397b501d9f6a232d153f328feb912f813c389061aac4cf72b04914fa5b74 (index-only digest; full 433 GiB checkpoint digest not recomputed)
run_provenance.model_revision: online production checkpoint as observed 2026-07-28; no repository revision metadata present
run_provenance.pre_measurement_incident: A structured guardian initially used sudo and self-deleted the first reservation before profiling began. Its false positive was preserved locally; all orphaned task processes were cgroup-verified and cleared, the pod was recreated, and both corrected guardians were clean before this capture.
run_provenance.profiler_gate: all four PP scheduler processes patched and verified; result sha256 bcbd2c504d6a7d70e7abc653d717e4e76680a50e1442a36a78b0277ffa772684
run_provenance.storage_deviation: none during measurement; CPFS was only the one-time source used to stage the checkpoint into production node-local /mnt/disk1
run_provenance.workload: 600 simultaneous x 100,000 input tokens x 1 output token; exact aggregate 90.000% in-GPU radix-cache hit via 450 x 89,984-token and 150 x 90,048-token reused prefixes

profile_start_note: t=0 is Nsight TARGET_INFO_SESSION_START_TIME. Client and CRI-shaped server timestamps are aligned to the session UTC epoch; bins before collection-ready are unavailable, not measured zero.

collection.boundary_semantics: externally recorded return from nsys start; earlier timeline region is uncollected, not measured zero

nccl_comm.interpretation: Aggregate communication/synchronization kernel residency; not useful model compute and not wall time.

coverage.request_join_policy: No server batch ID is assumed. Exact request/cache/completion facts come from client rows; PP0 is the canonical logical scheduler stage and PP1-PP3 are reconciliation evidence.

contract.peak_source: NVIDIA HGX B300 official dense FP4 specification
contract.logical_work: For request i, W_i = F(prompt_i) - F(cached_prefix_i), including the final LM head once. Cached-prefix model work is excluded; each new suffix still attends over its full context.
contract.precision_aware_work: Trace-anchored Tensor-Core math is expressed in dense-FP4 equivalents: routed NVFP4 x1, FP8 indexer/MLA x3, and BF16 attention/shared-expert GEMMs x6. Unverified or scalar/SFU/vector work stays unconverted and does not enter MFU.
contract.stable_allocation: The client-defined steady queue window selects PP0 scheduler new-token work. Page padding is removed with the full-run client/scheduler scale, then the exact client completion cohort supplies context-aware FP4-equivalent FLOPs per uncached token.
contract.request_evidence_authority: Persisted client rows are authoritative for per-request cached tokens because deployed server logs contain no joinable batch ID.

stable.method: Client steady gate: at least 12 consecutive 0.5-second metrics samples at the configured running-request floor with a positive queue; the interval ends at the final qualifying queued sample.

completion_gate.request_completion_authority: 600 persisted client EOF rows; server logs are not joined by batch ID

nccl_sendrecv.interpretation: Long-lived PP SendRecv communication/synchronization residency; not equivalent to useful model compute or wall time.

limitations: Standalone prefill-shaped run, not a real disaggregated PD KV transfer.
Dynamo registration, Mooncake, and hierarchical cache are intentionally absent.
Server scheduler rows lack a joinable batch ID; exact per-request cache hits and completions come from the client JSONL.
MFU excludes cached-prefix work but includes new-suffix attention over the full 100K causal context.
Aggregate per-device kernel residency is not wall time, occupancy, or useful FLOPs.
NCCL SendRecv residency includes pipeline communication and synchronization waiting.
The runtime warned that the checkpoint scale format is not ue8m0 and that FP8-KV scaling factors default to 1.0; this profile is not an accuracy validation.
